name: iching-takashima
description: I Ching cast by Takashima Donsho's method, step by step, in Chinese, English and Japanese: cast a hexagram by time, numbers or yarrow stalks with a fully reproducible derivation, then read the 64 judgments and 384 line texts with line-by-line interpretation, plus Takashima Donsho's original commentary and recorded cases. Sources cited; the bot makes no predictions of its own.

author.name: I Ching · Takashima Method 周易·高岛略筮
